title: Gifts to Future You: Setting and Holding Boundaries with Yourself
coreMove: A self-boundary holds when you make the future cost concrete, choose a kind guardrail, and treat tomorrow's peace as worth protecting right now.

exampleSpecs.domain: phone checking during quiet evening time
exampleSpecs.audience: Gwen and readers whose phones steal calm
exampleSpecs.stakes: A small peek can turn peaceful time into stress that outlasts the screen.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Gwen tracing the future cost of a phone peek after the stress has already spread.

exampleSpecs.audience: Oliver and readers who confuse zoning out with rest
exampleSpecs.stakes: Streaming can feel soothing while borrowing energy from the next morning.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Oliver treating the Netflix prompt as a sleep boundary rather than a character test.

exampleSpecs.audience: Maxime and readers whose spending urge discounts later pressure
exampleSpecs.stakes: A vague money goal loses to an immediate purchase unless the future cost becomes concrete.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Maxime making the cost of an online shopping habit concrete before the phone purchase goes through.

exampleSpecs.domain: indoor-smoking contrast on a rainy day
exampleSpecs.audience: Brielle and readers comparing external and internal boundaries
exampleSpecs.stakes: A guest's violation is easier to enforce than one's own repeated comfort behavior.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Brielle noticing how smoking in the house changes when the violator is herself.

exampleSpecs.domain: morning news checking on a phone
exampleSpecs.audience: Russell and readers who rely on willpower after the app is open
exampleSpecs.stakes: Fewer live decisions protect attention before comparison, anger, or stress can take over.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Russell benefiting from a guardrail that removed the phone decision before morning.

exampleSpecs.audience: Tao and readers who turn slips into self-attack
exampleSpecs.stakes: Harsh self-talk can make a broken self-boundary feel like proof that the whole practice failed.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Tao resetting a broken late-night boundary without using shame as enforcement.
